overview: Counting principles: permutation, combination, distribution of objects, lattice paths, recurrences, derangements, inclusion-exclusion, binary strings aur matrices/structures ki counting.
whyItMatters: 18 PYQs, 1990-2026; NAT counting aur recurrence based sawal recent saalon me.
coreConcept: Counting = multiplication principle (steps) + addition principle (cases) + complement/inclusion-exclusion. Order matter kare to permutation, warna combination.
hinglishExplanation: Pehle socho: order matter karta hai? Repetition allowed hai? Objects identical hain ya distinct? Phir formula chuno. Complicated conditions ke liye complement (total - bad) ya recurrence banao jaise f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2).
importantProperties: Arrangements of n objects with repeats: n!/(n1! n2! ...).
Identical objects into distinct boxes: C(n+k-1, k-1).
Distinct objects into distinct boxes: k^n.
Substrings of a string of length n: n(n+1)/2 (distinct positions).
Balanced-prefix binary strings: Catalan C(2n, n)/(n+1).
Binary string with no two consecutive 1s: Fibonacci recurrence.
Even-parity matrices: free choice of (n-1) x (n-1) submatrix: 2^((n-1)^2).
standardTechniques: Slot method for digit problems (constrained position pehle).
